noticias.titular: Williams' short-rest gem helps Guardians complete ALDS comeback
noticias.texto: Pitching on a day's rest, Gavin Williams had 12 of the Guardians' record 21 strikeouts in a 2-0 win over the White Sox to clinch the best-of-five ALDS after losing the first two games.
